text: This report recommends that the name "Silver Barn Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located in the block bounded by Yarmouth Road, Clinton Street, Follis Avenue and Christie Street. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Silver Barn Lane" for an existing public lane located in the block bounded by Yarmouth Road, Clinton Street, Follis Avenue and Christie Street.
